purpose: new closed-application fixture T0 diagnostic subset; not full R certification
primary: target final blocking-finding draw count / all 15 planned target draws; candidate count and final count retained
failurePolicy: retain every failed slot and raw report; no slot retry, extension, discard, denominator shrink, resume or fallback. Abort on safety/source drift. Native preexisting runner/JSON retries remain and are counted.
method: 60 native singleton invocations in preregistered random order; original draw=0 unchanged and external slot manifest supplies study draw index. No product source modification or merged Report.
blinding: production review prompts, fixture loader and sandbox unchanged. Spec oracle stays evaluator-only. Capture wrapper does not alter prompt/stream bytes.
instrumentation: CODEX_BIN transparent local capture wrapper executing exact native binary; T1 must use same wrapper. Not environment-equivalent to historical uninstrumented captures.
comparisonRestrictions: no old ambiguous-oracle FP causal comparison, no time-drift claim from T0 alone, no formal full-catalog certification or baseline
T1Analysis: if same frozen identity and valid windows, compare T1-T0 target rate with Wilson 95% intervals, difference interval, Fisher two-sided; p<=.05 and absolute increase >=1/3 for practical rise; one lane. Otherwise insufficient evidence.
preflight: none; exact binary/version verified locally and existing healthy native terra/high gates documented; wrapper nonmodel selfcheck passed
resources: existing local dependencies only, authorized existing model review account only, local report and captures only; no GitHub mutation, config/login change, runtime install or production effects
